result.instructions: Tools for ePoslovanje, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which e-invoices did we receive this month, and which are still waiting for approval?"; "Validate this UBL invoice before we send it to the customer."; "Show the status history of invoice 1234/1/2026 sent to our buyer.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ePoslovanje data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run eposlovanje_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run eposlovanje_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run eposlovanje_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. eposlovanje_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: eposlovanje_ping
tools.title: Check service and key
tools.description: Check that the ePoslovanje service is up and that the API key is accepted. Cheapest call. GET /api/v2/ping.

tools.name: eposlovanje_get_account_balance
tools.title: Get account balance
tools.description: Get the account type (Prepaid or Postpaid) and the prepaid balance, or the postpaid usage. GET /api/v2/account/balance.

tools.name: eposlovanje_get_f2_settings
tools.title: Get F2 fiscalization settings
tools.description: Get the automatic fiscalization settings for incoming and outgoing invoices (F2.0). GET /api/v2/account/f2settings.

tools.name: eposlovanje_list_business_units
tools.title: List business units
tools.description: List the business units (poslovne jedinice) of a company by its OIB, in the format used on e-invoices. GET /api/v2/businessunits/{vatid}.

tools.name: eposlovanje_list_incoming_documents
tools.title: List incoming documents
tools.description: List e-invoices received by the account (suppliers' invoices to us), with filters by insert, modify and issue date. GET /api/v2/document/incoming.

status.description: Document status: 1 pending, 2 sending, 3 sent, 4 delivered, 5 approved, 6 rejected, 7 fully paid.

tools.name: eposlovanje_list_outgoing_documents
tools.title: List outgoing documents
tools.description: List e-invoices sent by the account (our invoices to customers), with filters by insert, modify and issue date. GET /api/v2/document/outgoing.

status.description: Document status: 1 pending, 2 sending, 3 sent, 4 delivered, 5 approved, 6 rejected, 7 fully paid.

tools.name: eposlovanje_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Get the signed XML of one incoming or outgoing e-invoice by its ePoslovanje id. Archived documents may not be returned. GET /api/v2/document/get/{id}.

document_id.description: ePoslovanje document id (from the list tools).

tools.name: eposlovanje_get_document_status
tools.title: Get document status
tools.description: Get the status history (transport, business and e-reporting) of one document by its ePoslovanje id. GET /api/v2/document/status/{id}.

document_id.description: ePoslovanje document id (from the list tools).

tools.name: eposlovanje_lookup_document_status
tools.title: Look up document status by number
tools.description: Get the status of one invoice by its invoice number, both OIBs and the issue year (no ePoslovanje id needed). GET /api/v2/document/statuslookup.

document_number.description: Invoice or credit note number, for example 1234/1/2025.

annotations.title: Look up document status by number

tools.name: eposlovanje_validate_document
tools.title: Validate a document
tools.description: Validate an e-invoice XML against the EN16931 / CIUS-2025 rules without sending it. Returns a list of errors, empty when valid. POST /api/v2/document/validate. Nothing is stored or sent.

document.description: UBL 2.1 Invoice or CreditNote XML, as a string (EN16931 or CIUS-2025 with the Croatian extension).

tools.name: eposlovanje_list_ereporting_requests
tools.title: List e-reporting requests
tools.description: List the e-reporting (eIzvještavanje, Tax Authority fiscalization) requests for one invoice. GET /api/v2/ereporting/requests.

type.description: Request type: 1 outgoing invoice, 2 incoming invoice, 3 delivery without e-invoice, 4 payment, 5 rejection.

tools.name: eposlovanje_check_ams
tools.title: Check AMS registration
tools.description: Check whether a company (by OIB or GLN) is published on the Tax Authority AMS service, so e-invoices can reach it. POST /api/v2/ams/check. Read-only lookup.

tools.name: eposlovanje_send_document
tools.title: Send an e-invoice
tools.description: Send an UBL 2.1 Invoice or CreditNote XML to the buyer through ePoslovanje. The document is validated, signed, and queued for the buyer's intermediary. A sent invoice cannot be unsent. Each send costs about 0.08 EUR + VAT on the account. Use eposlovanje_validate_document first. POST /api/v2/document/send.

document.description: UBL 2.1 Invoice or CreditNote XML, as a string (EN16931 or CIUS-2025 with the Croatian extension).

send_as_email.description: true = send by e-mail to the buyer: skips the AMS check and automatic fiscalization.

tools.name: eposlovanje_change_document_status
tools.title: Change document status (buyer)
tools.description: Set the business status of a received invoice: 5 approved, 6 rejected, 7 fully paid. Changing to rejected does not send an e-reporting request. Only the buyer can change these statuses. POST /api/v2/document/changestatus/{id}.

document_id.description: ePoslovanje document id (from the list tools).

changed_on.description: ISO-8601 date-time when the status changed, for example 2026-11-11T10:00:00+01:00.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with ePoslovanje
prompts.description: What you can do with ePoslovanje here, with example requests to try.
